Whole unchanged production driver/structs/API: independent axes/sources, real injected generation changes, transparent source edges, stale payload cancellation, reset/init and original sync
Actual driver API plus real ZMK layer event dispatch; ordered per-source/axis samples and transparent buttons, 3 repeats per supported core

execution.default: quick: every host behavioral fixture and scenario under ASan/UBSan once; offline-admission and coverage-validator units once
execution.full: Same host cases under sanitizers/optimization and complete arithmetic/driver line/branch coverage; supported-core ARM/native entries remain separate
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute

fixtures.asserts: Supported clean dependency pins, missing inputs, safe project/output/symlink layout and fresh outputs; reject unowned settings fixture selection
Complete-driver entry rejects empty/unrelated/missing-function/unexecuted line/branch reports and invalid mode/retired selectors
Canonical host entry includes selected-workspace/cache-symlink/poisoned-environment tests; keep-ambient negative control must fail through that entry

infrastructure.preparation: Explicit pinned offline workspace; local unchanged ZMK clone and original fixture manifest; no fetch or source repair
infrastructure.limits: Admission tests control dependency responses. Actual native/API/firmware fixtures separately verify unchanged stock ZMK and DYA. Physical transport remains separate.

integer_width.production: 32-bit arithmetic; independent wider oracles remain test-only
integer_width.contract: Coordinate subtraction uses checked 32-bit saturation. The two-sample average splits each operand into quotient/remainder and applies one signed truncation, preserving the full int32 coordinate contract without a wide sum.
integer_width.fixtures: test_absolute_to_relative_core.c retains full-range saturation and independent histories; the signed-average grid compares every small positive/negative pair with an independent wide reference.

source_capacity.default: CONFIG_ZMK_INPUT_ABS2REL_MAX_SOURCES=0 preserves every enabled listener index, minimum one NULL fallback. Positive 1..256 is an explicit prefix of original global uint8 indices; no remapping.
source_capacity.guard: Enabled listeners with enabled devices: base and every child route, including disabled children. A referenced index outside the bound is a named build rejection. Direct callers must fit the same bound.
source_capacity.runtime: All 256 lookup IDs under six host profiles, every retained coordinate independent, NULL/invalid behavior and generation resets; all original whole-driver scenarios remain.
source_capacity.native: Fixed original sparse auto and low auto/limited/wide/fallback/disabled-device/disabled-listener profiles, five named build rejections, strict ASan+UBSan auto. Canonical dispatch ignores ambient profile variables. Explicit --control is focused and never a complete-matrix PASS.
source_capacity.measurement: Matched baseline/default/limited Cortex-M objects on both supported cores, actual state/function code bytes/compiler frames. Default automatic code and state remain identical. Each source costs 28 bytes per node; five-to-two saves 84 bytes per node.
source_capacity.physical: NOT RUN; installed-image HID/BLE/split, timing, power and stack high-water remain separate.
